title: Universal Leading Quantum Stress Near the Schwarzschild Singularity
summary: Determining the local quantum source near a spacelike singularity is essential for assessing semiclassical backreaction inside black holes. By standard point splitting, we provide, to our knowledge, the first complete numerical determination of the renormalized stress-energy tensor (RSET) of a massless scalar field at arbitrary curvature coupling in the four-dimensional Schwarzschild interior. Calculations in the Unruh and Hartle--Hawking states reach $r/M\simeq10^{-4}$, yielding a common leading $r^{-6}$ coefficient tensor and coupling-dependent anisotropic pressure ratios. Uniform…
